name: Highperch
summary: Wild wyverns nest among the crags of Highperch, above the western Thousand Needles canyon. Their prides guard the heights and their young.

sections.title: Aerie of the Wyverns
sections.body:
Highperch rises from the canyon floor, giving Kalimdor’s native wyverns a rugged refuge. Its height shields them from predators and offers a clear launch for hunts across Thousand Needles.

Wyvern prides guard their nests under watchful patriarchs and matriarchs. They fiercely defend their territory from any intruder who reaches their high domain.

sections.title: A Refuge in the Heights
sections.body:
The cliffs draw a few travelers and hunters willing to brave the climb. Pao'ka Swiftmountain, a tauren scout, is stranded on the heights and needs help reaching Whitereach Post.

Those who climb the cliffs face dozens of razor-sharp talons and venomous tails.

faq.answer: Wild wyverns and wind riders live at Highperch. Protective patriarchs, consorts, and soaring adults defend their clifftop nests.
Highperch rises in western Thousand Needles. A winding ramp follows the canyon’s southern wall to the heights.

faq.q: Why is Highperch significant to the Horde?
aliases: why do orcs care about highperch
faq.answer: Wyverns, also called wind riders, are vital flying mounts of the Horde. They allied with the orcs during the Third War, and roosts like Highperch hold a thriving wild population.
Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a tauren scout stranded among Highperch’s wyvern nests. He needs an escort to Whitereach Post.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you can see the wild kin of the wind riders that carry your people across Kalimdor.
As a hunter, you can watch wild wyverns hunt and guard their nests in their natural home.
